definitions.explanation: A person who has committed a crime; the perpetrator of a crime.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}はまだ{捕|つか}まっていない。
examples.english: The criminal hasn't been caught yet.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{特定|とくてい}することができた。
examples.english: We were able to identify the culprit.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{逃走|とうそう}した。

notes:
USAGE: {犯人|はんにん} refers specifically to someone who has committed a crime. It's commonly used in news reports and crime stories.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{犯人|はんにん}を{捕|つか}まえる (to catch the criminal)
・{犯人|はんにん}を{逮捕|たいほ}する (to arrest the criminal)
・{犯人|はんにん}が{逃|に}げる (the criminal escapes)
・{真|しん}{犯人|はんにん} (the real culprit)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{犯人|はんにん}{逮捕|たいほ} (criminal's arrest)
・{犯人|はんにん}{捜索|そうさく} (search for criminal)
・{犯人|はんにん}の{目星|めぼし} (suspect/lead on the criminal)
・{犯人|はんにん}{像|ぞう} (profile of the criminal)

RELATED WORDS:
・{容疑者|ようぎしゃ} - suspect (formal, legal)
・{被疑者|ひぎしゃ} - suspect (legal term)
・{犯罪者|はんざいしゃ} - criminal (general term)
